image_location_description: Bottom of image: both chunky white feet on ground; tan/gold striping sits on lower legs above feet.

steps.title: Left foot base
steps.description: Stack 3021 white 2x3 plate + 3021 white 2x3 plate; add 3024 white 1x1 at toe center.

steps.title: Right foot base
steps.description: Repeat Step 1 for the right foot (same parts/placement).

steps.title: Add ankle plates
steps.description: Place 3022 white 2x2 on rear half of each foot (centered).

steps.title: Left shin block
steps.description: On left ankle: add two 3004 white 1x2 bricks side-by-side (2x2).

steps.title: Right shin block
steps.description: On right ankle: add two 3004 white 1x2 bricks side-by-side (2x2).

steps.title: Tan striping
steps.description: Top-front of each shin: add 3023 tan 1x2 plate as a stripe band.

steps.title: Lock shins together
steps.description: Bridge shins with 3023 white 1x2 plate across the back/top studs.
